Architecture Overview

How HospitalityOS is Structured: Small to Big

A progressive continuum connecting frontline micro-tasks directly to multi-property executive intelligence

System Hierarchy
Tier 5 · The AI Brain
AI General Manager & WhatsApp Concierge · Natural language queries, automated upselling, reputation shield, multi-tenant group console.
Tier 4 · Revenue & Audit
Financial Automation & Energy CPOR · Dynamic Virtual Accounts (DVA), automated night audit, 2-way OTA channel sync, generator fuel tracking.
Tier 3 · Back-of-House
Inventory, Recipes & Procurement · Ingredient-level recipe depletion, central store & cellar transfers, waste tracking, automated purchase orders.
Tier 2 · Guest Outlets
Front Desk, CRM & Multi-Outlet POS · Visual tape chart rack, direct booking engine, restaurant/bar POS, Kitchen Display System (KDS), thermal receipt printing.
Tier 1 · Micro-Tasks
Ground Operations & Staffing · Room status lifecycle, housekeeping room turns, maintenance work orders, geofenced clock-in, till shift balance.

Room Operations & Housekeeping Task Engine

Precision room status lifecycle and real-time mobile task dispatching for floor attendants

Rooms & Housekeeping
🛏️
Room Lifecycle Engine
State machine governing every unit across the property.
  • Clean / Dirty Tracking: Triggers automatically on guest checkout.
  • Inspected Status: Supervisor sign-off required before front desk check-in.
  • Out of Order (OOO): Blocks inventory from booking engines and rack.
  • Out of Service (OOS): Temporary maintenance hold without inventory loss.
Operational Speed
-40% Room Turn Time
📸
Hygiene Checklist & Photo Proof
Stayflexi-grade quality control: mandatory photo evidence and supervisor inspection.
  • 4-Point Hygiene Turnover: Linen replacement, bathroom disinfection, floor mopping, amenities restocking.
  • Camera Photo Proof: Attendant uploads turnover photo before room moves to AWAITING_INSPECTION.
  • Supervisor 1-Click Pass/Fail: Supervisors review photo proof & approve room to AVAILABLE or reject for reclean.
  • Maintenance Auto-Escalation: One-tap defect tagging creates immediate repair tickets.
Cleanliness Assurance
100% Photo-Verified Clean
🔑
Keycard & Access Control
Frontline lock encoding and electronic access interfaces.
  • Encoder Integration: Writes magnetic stripe & RFID cards at check-in.
  • Duration Locking: Keycards expire automatically at 12:00 PM checkout.
  • Duplicate Key Safety: Generates extra keys while retaining security logs.
  • Staff Master Pass: Dedicated logs for housekeeping master access.
Security
Zero Lock Drift

Confidential Staff Grievances & Whistleblower Engine

Encrypted worker-to-worker reporting safeguarding hotel integrity with total whistleblower anonymity

Ethics & Integrity
🛡️
AES-256 Encrypted Anonymity
Anonymous whistleblowing channel protecting staff from workplace retaliation.
  • Field-Level Encryption: Plaintext identity dropped; reporterIdEnc secured with AES-256-GCM.
  • Incident Categories: Theft suspicion, harassment, policy violations, safety hazards, and misconduct.
  • Digital Evidence Vault: Staff attach photos, audio, or document URLs directly to support reports.
  • Audited Ledger: System audits the act of submission without exposing identity or case notes.
Whistleblower Trust
100% Retaliation Proof
👁️
Strict RBAC & Accused Lockout
Automated access isolation ensuring only authorized leaders handle cases.
  • Executive-Only Access: Restricted strictly to OWNER & MANAGER roles; all other staff tiers blocked.
  • Accused Subject Quarantine: The reported employee is programmatically blocked from seeing the report.
  • Confidential Event Log: Chronological case notes, updates, and evidence submissions tracked immutably.
  • Push Alert System: Immediate high-priority notification dispatched exclusively to general manager terminals.
Information Security
Zero Internal Leaks
⚖️
Case Review & Remediation
Standardized review lifecycle from initial complaint to formal resolution.
  • Resolution Lifecycle: Structured states (SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, ACTION_TAKEN, RESOLVED, DISMISSED).
  • Remediation Governance: Logs formal warnings, staff retraining, policy revisions, or disciplinary outcomes.
  • Staff Profile Linking: Action notes attach to subject user profile for permanent HR records.
  • Leadership Visibility Feed: Dedicated manager review hub tracking pending grievance turnaround times.
Remediation SLA
< 48h Escalation Window

Tier 4 · Financial Automation

Standout Moat: Dynamic Virtual Accounts (DVA)

Eliminating fake transfer receipts and receptionist fraud with instant bank transfer reconciliation

Automated Banking

In emerging and high-growth markets, over 70% of hotel payments occur via direct bank transfers. Conventional hotels waste 15-45 minutes waiting for receptionists to verify SMS alerts or login to banking apps—frequently falling victim to fake receipt fraud.

⚡
How HospitalityOS Reconciles in < 3 Seconds:
  • Dedicated 10-Digit NUBAN: Every booking gets a unique temporary virtual bank account.
  • Zero Terminal Reliability Issues: Works when POS card machines fail or network is down.
  • Instant Webhook Capture: Bank transfers trigger immediate webhook to the PMS.
  • Auto-Confirm HELD Bookings: Automatically confirms room and issues WhatsApp receipt.
1
Guest Receives Account
WhatsApp or Desk displays: Providus / Moniepoint Bank · 9928172910 · "Grand Hotel - Mr. Ade (Res #82A)"
2
Guest Transfers via Any Banking App
Guest sends exact balance from GTBank, Zenith, Kuda, etc. via standard instant NIP transfer.
3
3-Second Instant Auto-Reconciliation
Folio balance drops to $0.00, keycard unlocks, and instant WhatsApp confirmation is dispatched.

  • Immediate GM Escalation: Opens an urgent resolution ticket for the General Manager to call the guest before public venting occurs.

Offline-First Synchronization Engine
